scope: Read-only source audit of the current adjective sentence producer and rule-first comparative pilot; no Production calls or writes.

source_evidence.observation: The producer preserves canonical token ID, source candidate ID, lexeme ID and competing IDs; it withholds or marks ambiguous rather than choosing POS.
The generic evaluator adds only supporting graph evidence to a lexical reading, with no resolve/reject transition.
The current rule-first pilot admits only one exact lexeme/article/snapshot; this is a lexeme-scoped shadow contract, not sentence POS authority.
The trusted handler takes lexemeId and derives a comparative candidate while returning activationAuthority=false and graphMutation=false; it does not take a canonical sentence token.
Production sentence shadow attaches supporting context to åpen and preserves candidate status; ambiguous controls abstain.

disposition: Independent POS resolution is not a prerequisite for evaluating a rule as a candidate-scoped shadow hypothesis. It remains required, together with rule applicability and competing-reading checks, before selecting a reading or admitting a learner-facing result.
missing_contract: A versioned bridge must bind canonical token ID + source candidate ID + lexeme ID + source POS + source snapshot before invoking the private rule-first operator.
The bridge must preserve every competing token reading, run only admitted rule/lexeme combinations, and attach the derived form to the same candidate without promoting POS or activating a rule.
The current SQL/Edge comparative pilot accepts lexeme ID only and has no sentence-token binding; the existing sentence producer does not invoke it.
The sentence-admission gate remains UNVERIFIED until an independent applicability proof and positive/negative corpus establish when candidate results may become definitive.
next_executable_gate: On En åpen bok, bind the exact åpen candidate to its canonical token, invoke the existing private rule-first pilot in shadow, attach its result as candidate-only evidence, and prove that both bok readings remain. On Han er åpen, En åpen dør and wrong candidate/snapshot controls, withhold or retain ambiguity.
